correctness.rationale: For a>0 and even d, y decreases; if bounded below it converges and summability of (x+y)^d forces x+y->0 and then both coordinates->0. Otherwise y->-infty and x_{n+1}<=y_n forces x->-infty. On escaping tail z_n=x_n-y_n=a|s_{n-1}|^d>=0, r_{n+1}=r_n+z_n+3a r_n^d, and 0<=z_n<=r_n/3. Hence 0<e_n<=4r_n^(1-d)/(9a)->0 and rescaled logarithms obey w_{n+1}=d*w_n+log(1+e_n). Summable weighted corrections give positive H and an o(1) additive residual, yielding universal prefactor. Direction follows by division of exact coordinate maps by |s|^d. Sign conjugacy proves a<0. Every premise is established for all real orbits; exact-integer script corroborates finite identities but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source explicitly focuses on the global geometry and topology of a compact nonhyperbolic attraction basin of a secant-method model. Its complement is the natural other global dynamical regime. The theorem gives a complete dynamical fate and nontrivial quantitative invariant there: all exterior real initial conditions asymptote to the same signed projective ray but retain an orbit-dependent positive escape height with universal exact exponential prefactor. The height and decay of relative direction error give strong comparison of divergent orbits and are not determined by the basin topology or coordinate monotonicity alone. This is specific enough to the originating model to merit the exact classification even without a broader new theorem.
